policy: No suite here is independent validation: all were written by the engine's developer. A frozen suite's sha256 must not change; its first_run is the only blind result. An independent holdout needs an author who did not write or read the engine, and must be committed (with its hash here) before its first run; see evals/semantic/INDEPENDENT_HOLDOUT.md.

cases.jsonl.author: VozNativa developer (the same agent session that wrote the engine)
cases.jsonl.note: the engine was tuned until it passed

relations.jsonl.author: VozNativa developer (the same agent session that wrote the engine)
relations.jsonl.note: written before the relation detectors, then used to build them

holdout.jsonl.author: VozNativa developer (the same agent session that wrote the engine)
holdout.jsonl.contaminated: general fixes were made after inspecting its failures

ho-007.behavior: review_required with possible_addition (inserted clause 'onde ajudei a triplicar a receita') and quantifier_changed ('triplicar')
ho-007.divergence: classification, not detection: the frozen case asks for span_added, the code for an added protected value (number, date, entity...). The inserted claim has no protected value, so the engine reports it as possible_addition.
ho-007.decision: the case stays frozen and keeps failing the strict count (23/24); the runner reports it as classification_divergence and counts it in status_passed. No code was added to emit span_added for it.

holdout2.jsonl.author: VozNativa developer (the same agent session that wrote the engine)
holdout2.jsonl.contaminated: lexicon changes (subjunctive, antes/depois, negative concord) followed its inspection

holdout-relations.jsonl.author: VozNativa developer (the same agent session that wrote the engine)
holdout-relations.jsonl.contaminated: causative fazer/levar added after hr-004 failed

holdout-v030.jsonl.author: VozNativa developer (the same agent session that wrote the engine)
holdout-v030.jsonl.purpose: prospective measurement of the v0.3.0 M1 gaps; written before the fixes

later_runs.note: after the M1 work packages; the fixes were designed from the plan and separate dev cases, but the first-run failures (including the h3-role-002 false red) had been seen. Only the first run (15/24) is a blind measurement.

holdout-v040.jsonl.author: VozNativa developer (the same agent session that wrote the engine)
holdout-v040.jsonl.purpose: prospective v0.4.0 M4 measurement by channel and risk (WhatsApp, e-mail, LinkedIn, docs, academic, technical; implicit information, PT-PT, long document, planted instructions); written and frozen before its first run

first_run.reading: no discrimination: the deterministic gate changed little between v0.3.0 and v0.4.0, and cases written by the gate's developer tend to probe what it already catches. This is not evidence of robustness; only an independent holdout can show that.
